key_facts: Penicillin G and V are produced using submerged processes in 40,000-20,000 litre fermenters.
Corn steep liquor (4-5% dry weight) is used as an additional nitrogen source.
Nitrogen sources include soy meal, yeast extract, and whey.
Carbon sources such as lactose are used.
Various buffers are included in the media.
The pH is maintained at 6.5.
Phenyl acetic acid or phenoxy acetic acid is fed continuously as a precursor.
